blocks.title: Inspect and manage Cloudflare resources from Vetta
blocks.description: Connect through Cloudflare's browser authorization, choose the permissions to grant, and work across the Cloudflare API without sharing an API token in chat.

showcase.user_prompt: List the Workers in my selected account and explain which ones have recent deployment failures. Do not change anything.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll use only the permissions you granted, inspect the relevant resources, and keep this request read-only. I’ll ask separately before any change.

blocks.title: Broad API coverage with a small tool surface

items.title: Find the right API
items.description: Search Cloudflare's broad API surface instead of loading thousands of endpoint definitions into the conversation.

items.title: Read account state
items.description: Inspect zones, DNS, Workers, storage, security and other resources covered by the permissions you grant.

items.title: Make explicit changes
items.description: Create or update resources when requested, while keeping the granted Cloudflare scope and Vetta confirmations in control.

items.title: Install and continue
items.description: Choose Cloudflare API in the Cloudflare Developer Platform package, then continue to browser authorization.

items.title: Select permissions
items.description: Sign in to Cloudflare and grant only the accounts, resources and actions needed for your work.

items.title: State the boundary
items.description: Tell Vetta whether the request is read-only or may change resources, and review important operations before they run.

blocks.title: This connection can change real resources
blocks.content: Depending on the permissions you grant, operations can modify DNS, deployments, storage, security settings and other account resources, and some services can incur charges. Start with a test account or least-privilege scope and verify important results.

blocks.title: How Code Mode works
blocks.content: Cloudflare exposes a compact search-and-execute interface. Generated API orchestration code runs in an isolated Cloudflare Worker with outbound access restricted by the service; it does not run as a local installation in Vetta.
